entries.reason: outcome differs by install channel (verified 2026-07-17): on the stable/latest channel moon build --target llvm fails (internal compiler error, exit 255); on the nightly channel it builds with a warning that LLVM is experimental. No single exit-code expectation holds across CI lanes, so this entry documents rather than runs.

argv:
extern "C" fn release_exit(code : Int) = "exit"
fn main { release_exit(7) }

steps.script:
cat > moon.mod <<'MBTEOF'
name = "mbtskills/optform"
version = "0.1.0"

options(
  "preferred-target": "js",
)
MBTEOF

cat > moon.pkg <<'MBTEOF'
rule(
  name: "embed_text",
  command: ":embed -i $input -o $output --name greeting_text",
)

dev_build(
  rule: "embed_text",
  input: "greeting.txt",
  output: "greeting.mbt",
)
MBTEOF

cat > app/moon.mod <<'MBTEOF'
name = "mbtskills/app"
version = "0.1.0"

import {
  "mbtskills/base@0.2.0",
}
MBTEOF

cat > app/moon.mod <<'MBTEOF'
name = "mbtskills/app"
version = "0.1.0"

import {
  "mbtskills/base@0.2.0",
}
MBTEOF
printf 'fn main { println("from stdin") }' | moon run -
